description: This file contains unit tests for the LeaveEntitlementAPI within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It defines test cases for retrieving all leave entitlements and a specific leave entitlement by ID, utilizing mock services and fixtures.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for LeaveEntitlementAPI covering getAll and getOne methods using mock setup and fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all leave entitlements through the API, using a data provider for parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single leave entitlement by ID through the API, utilizing a data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetOne method, sourced from a YAML file.
